intent.business_goal:
﻿Test Case: Gajab End-to-End Customer Journey Automation

Website: https://stg.gajab.com/
Test Credentials:
- Mobile Number: random 10 digit number
- OTP: '123456'
- Name: Test User
- Gender: Male
- Pin Code: '560001'
- Email: qa.automation@gajab.com
- Product Brand: SERA'S BASKET
- Price Range: 427 to 727
- Product: Classic 15.7 Inch Soft Tip Dartboard Game Set
- Payment Method: Net Banking

Steps:
1. Launch browser
2. Navigate to url 'https://stg.gajab.com/'
3. Verify that home page is visible
4. Click on 'Log in' or 'Sign up' button
5. Verify url contains 'signin' after page loads
6. Wait for the page to load completely and ensure all elements are visible
7. Enter random 10 digit mobile number in mobile field
8. Click on the check box for terms and conditions
9. Click 'Request OTP' button
10. Enter OTP '123456' in OTP field
11. Wait for account creation form page to appear
12. Enter name 'Test User' in name field
13. Click on 'Male' button for gender selection
14. Click on 'Submit' or 'Next' button to create account
15. Verify account created successfully message appears
16. Click on location dropdown or location search field
17. Wait for location search field to become active
18. Enter pin code '560001' in location search field
19. Verify location results are displayed
20. Select the location from search results or dropdown
21. Verify location is applied successfully
22. Verify that Gajab Deal of the Day section is visible
23. Capture the product name from Deal of the Day
24. Capture the product image from Deal of the Day
25. Capture the asking price from Deal of the Day
26. Click share or email button for Deal of the Day product
27. Send product image, product name, and asking price to email 'qa.automation@gajab.com'
28. Verify email sent confirmation message
29. Navigate to Trending Products section
30. Identify the most-bargained product under Trending Products
31. Capture screenshot of the most-bargained product
32. Scroll to Just Bargained section
33. Capture the name and city of the latest live order
34. Click on View All link in Just Bargained Product section
35. Identify the cheapest product among the most-bargained products
36. Click on Toys and Games category tab
37. Click on SERA'S BASKET brand from the left filter
38. Click on price range filter and set from 427 to 727
39. Click on Classic 15.7 Inch Soft Tip Dartboard Game Set from search results
40. Click on the selected product
41. Click on Bargain button to start bargaining
42. Enter bargain offer and submit
43. Wait for seller response to bargain offer
44. Enter another bargain offer and submit
45. Wait for seller response to bargain offer
46. Enter final bargain offer and submit
47. Wait for seller response to bargain offer
48. Click on Accept button to accept the final bargain offer
49. Click on Buy Now button
50. Click on Pay Online payment option
51. Click on Pay button
52. Click on Net Banking option
53. Click on a bank from the list
54. Complete payment on bank portal
55. Click on Success button to confirm payment
56. Verify order placed successfully message
57. Verify order details are displayed
58. Navigate to My Bargains section
59. Verify the savings displayed
60. Verify bargained product is listed in My Bargains
61. Verify deal details match the bargained offer
62. Logout from the application
63. Verify logout successful message
notes: Fallback interpreter used because no LLM response was available.
